documents.population: All undergraduate applicants (UCAS); international applicants included
documents.notes: University-wide application process page (UCAS) and the Computing BEng course page (TMUA, English). Interviews are 'not standard'. The course page's English requirement is a standard university qualification requirement, recorded as the English language test report.

items.quote: You can only submit one personal statement with your application. So it needs to cover all your course choices.
Only one reference is required for your UCAS application from someone who knows you academically.
To be eligible for selection for this course for 2027 entry, you must sit the Test of Mathematics for University Admission (TMUA) as part of the application process.
All candidates must demonstrate a minimum level of English language proficiency for admission to the university.
